capabilities: Exports the current note as a tagged PDF/UA-1 file
Tags headings, lists, tables, links, code and callouts in reading order
Embeds vault images with their written descriptions
Saves the PDF beside the note or in a chosen vault folder
Configures page size, document language and note-name title heading
extras: Desktop only, tested on Obsidian 1.14.4 for Linux; one note at a time, no folder export. During export it writes a hidden temporary page file in its own plugin folder. Passing veraPDF/PAC is not the same as a good reading experience; PDFs not yet tested with a screen reader. The author also runs a free unrelated web PDF checker at cybernative.ai that the plugin does not contact.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Export to PDF produces untagged PDFs: no structure, no document language and no PDF/UA marker.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Export to PDF produces untagged PDFs with no structure, language or PDF/UA marker, so screen readers cannot navigate them and checkers like veraPDF and PAC fail them.
summary: Exports an Obsidian note as a tagged PDF/UA-1 file so screen readers can navigate headings, lists, tables, links and images.
